scope: Hash-bound AC1018 physical HEADER page and decoded envelope accounting for one external local sample; no parser behavior was changed.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
rules: The R2004 section map identifies the HEADER section and its pages.
The decoded AcDb:Header envelope contains a begin sentinel, declared data size, CRC, and end sentinel; the logical section boundary determines whether any bytes remain unclaimed.

source.provenanceLimit: The file is from a local ACadSharp sample checkout; its producer and source-generation provenance were not established. It is not a repository fixture.

decodedHeaderEnvelope.crcDisposition: The instrumented reader trace prints stored and calculated CRC 0x3066 and emits no HeaderSectionCrc diagnostic. The calculation is from the libdxfrw reader itself, not an independent CRC implementation.

implementationObservation.observation: The reader decoded and parsed the HEADER envelope with zero unclaimed bytes and the trace showed stored and calculated CRC values matching at 0x3066. Whole-file DXF export later stopped at strict IMAGEDEF/reactor source-correlation preflight; that later failure does not establish a HEADER failure.

limitations: One local sample with unknown producer provenance does not qualify an AC1018 producer profile.

The exact-header sample does not classify the separate 739-byte unclaimed suffix in the two ODA File Converter AC1018 maintenance-55 witnesses documented in p6-ac1018-oda-header-suffix-diagnostic-admission-2026-11-03.json.
No output or support claim is promoted; the ODA-produced suffix cases remain strictly refused.

validation.scope: Generated envelope/version controls exercise parser behavior; the AC1018 external sample is a trace observation, not a committed test fixture.
